Common questions

Things business owners ask us

Which platforms should my business be on?

It depends on your customers. Most consumer businesses do well on Instagram and Facebook, while B2B brands often need LinkedIn. We recommend the right mix in the free review.

Do you create the content?

Yes. We plan the calendar and create posts, carousels, reels and captions, then share everything with you for approval.

Will you reply to comments and messages?

Yes. Community management is included, so questions get answered and interested people aren’t missed.

How soon will I see results?

Your pages look active straight away. Trust, reach and enquiries build over the following months with consistent posting.

Is paid advertising included?

Social media management focuses on your pages and content. Paid ads are a separate service (Meta Ads) and work well together with it.

Who owns the pages?

You do. Your accounts stay in your name, and we work on them with access you control.

How much does social media management cost?

It depends on the platforms and how much content you need. We share a clear quote after the free review.
